# On and off by default — the `fastapi` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#fastapi).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** never — installing the pack is the opt-in.
- **Rules:** 3 — 0 on, 0 on with `preview = true`, 2 off in an opt-in preset, 1 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `fastapi/recommended` | no — opt in | 2 | 2 warn | the 2 Ruff's `FAST` rules (Ruff 0.16.9) that Ruff calls stable, reimplemented (W-139) |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.

| Rule | By default | Severity | Preset |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`fastapi/fast-api-non-annotated-dependency`](../fastapi/fast-api-non-annotated-dependency.md) | off — opt-in preset | — | `fastapi/recommended` |
| [`fastapi/fast-api-redundant-response-model`](../fastapi/fast-api-redundant-response-model.md) | off — opt-in preset | — | `fastapi/recommended` |
| [`fastapi/fast-api-unused-path-parameter`](../fastapi/fast-api-unused-path-parameter.md) | off — in no preset | — | — |
